scope: User-authorized Passlib + bcrypt integration; local verification only

password_policy.nul_compatibility: Direct pyca bcrypt preserves previously accepted NUL passwords; same algorithm and cost

checks.requirements_dev_dry_run: all requirements already satisfied; not a fresh install
checks.targeted_pip_audit: No known vulnerabilities found for passlib==1.7.4 and bcrypt==4.3.0; not a new full dependency scan

coverage: New hashes interoperate with direct bcrypt and have random salt
Legacy bcrypt hashes, Unicode, whitespace and 72-byte boundary remain compatible
Overlong input and malformed hashes are rejected without password truncation
NUL compatibility does not strip or truncate password
Legacy account HTTP login/me/logout preserves stored hash
initial_failed_check: Pre-change auth baseline: 12 database setup errors and 1 pass because local PostgreSQL was stopped. Existing local cluster restarted; full regression subsequently passed on the separate test database.
known_warnings: Passlib logs caught error reading bcrypt __about__ version metadata on initialization; real hash/verify succeeded. No logger suppression, metadata monkeypatch or bcrypt downgrade.
Two existing pytest deprecations: Starlette HTTPX TestClient and AnyIO BlockingPortal alias
